title: Machines
description: [Nova-Addon] Quarries, Pulverizers, Generators and a lot more
body:
### Dependencies
Requires [Nova](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-framework) ([Installation Guide](https://docs.xenondevs.xyz/nova/admin/setup/)) and [Simple Upgrades](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nova-simple-upgrades).

# Machines
![An image of the blocks from Machines](https://i.imgur.com/H4hGlWv.png)
![Power Generation: There are multiple different power generators available. Pick the one that suits your needs. (Solar Panel, Coal Generator, Wind Turbine, Lightning Exchanger)](https://i.imgur.com/S6vEDr9.png)
![Quarry: The Quarry lets you easily mine huge chunks of the world to gain resources. Integrates with WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, Plot² and GriefDefender to prevent griefing in your world.](https://i.imgur.com/YeCB8WO.png)
![Tree Factory: With the Tree Factory, you can grow little trees inside a box and collect their resources.](https://i.imgur.com/SEhAAP5.png)
![Ore Duplication: All ores and raw metals can be pulverized into two dusts, which can then be smelted to ingots.](https://i.imgur.com/hGXzLte.png)
![Mob Farming: Automate Mob Farming with the Mob Breeder, Mob Duplicator, and Mob Killer](https://i.imgur.com/rMdUG8D.png)

... and much more!
